data.title: Request for accident questionnaire and wildlife damage certificate after a deer collision
data.summary: Kfz-Versicherung Beispielsicher AG asks Mr Musterquell, following his reported collision with a deer on 9 November 2026 (claim no. KS-26-1109-218), to send back the completed accident questionnaire and a wildlife damage certificate from the gamekeeper or police within 13 working days of the letter's date to process his partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) claim.
data.explanation: The insurer needs two documents to settle your deer-collision claim under your partial comprehensive cover (Teilkasko): the filled-in questionnaire they enclosed, and a certificate confirming the wildlife damage, issued by either the local gamekeeper or the police. Send both back by the deadline shown by the app, which counts working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the letter's date. If you miss it, your claim processing could be delayed or the insurer may ask again; contact them if you need more time or have trouble getting the certificate.
